newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads citizen for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads citizen for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Tuesday beheaded a Saudi man for murder, raising to 47 the number of executions this year in the kingdom, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement carried on state-run Saudi television said he was executed after being found guilty of shooting to death another man in a dispute.
Conservative Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
